notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.14.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]Patch 1.0.14.0[/b] is out now!

Here is the full list of changes in this patch: 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/aab7b966b709466d37996339986c1286f272ac03.gif[/img]

[b]Following community feedback, we’ve decided to rework the fetching behavior of the blue pig. The pig should now be more actively participating in collecting items for the players:[/b]
[list][*] If an item is present in his basket, the blue pig will make an effort to collect this type of item whether he is following a player or asked to sit.
[*] When the blue pig is asked to sit, he will actively fetch any item in his vicinity if his basket isn’t full (previously an item would be fetched only if that type was already present in the basket).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/f7086ca5f8b1d346282252d85c0f03b063df4097.png[/img]

[b]We included two UI tweaks that were suggested by the community:[/b]
[list][*] Added the current day number at the bottom of the shack’s reputation menu (pause menu) to be able to track your progress without having to return to the main menu. 
[*] Added reward names granted from reputation levels to the mail letters and the pause menu for better legibility (previously only the icon was shown).
[/list]
[b]Other fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some NPCs' hats and other accessories wouldn't be included in their outline highlight.
[*] Fixed lumberjack being upright for the client while being down for the server at the beginning of Chasse Galerie quest.
[*] Fixed an issue where WASD movement keys didn't properly display in the tutorial message due to adding arrow keys as alternate controls in patch 1.0.13.
[/list]

Please let us know of any bugs you run into in our [url=https://discord.gg/tsyAn5gCSV]Discord[/url]!

If you haven't done so already, we would love to see your honest thoughts on the game with a Steam review. Reviews can make a huge different for indie games and we love seeing what you think!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]Patch 1.0.12[/b] is out now!

We’ve been listening to player feedback since launch and one of the elements that was brought up was that sometimes the controls felt a bit clunky or didn’t match with the object the player intended to interact with. We’ve implemented a new aim outline that will automatically highlight interactable objects in front of your character.

This should make it much clearer which object you’re about to interact with and make the experience much more enjoyable. You can see below the feature in effect. In case you would prefer to play without the outline, it can also be disabled in the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/25298f632cc74e09a5ce09ed28c1502e25305d7c.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[b]Here is the full list of changes in this patch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added aim outline so players can see which objects they will interact with.
[*] Added option to disable aim outline in the options menu, under “aim outline”.
[*] Fixed basket not being throwable or droppable when on a garden
[*] Fixed Blue pig sometimes not spawning properly
[*] Fixed garden and other obstacles being covered in snow on client side after placing a new tile
[*] Fixed Expo67 quest description missing Corriveau icon when choosing a companion for Walker
[*] Added some missing localization strings for network errors when the game couldn’t connect to Steam or couldn’t create an online game.
[*] Fixed key bindings being reset after restarting the game. Binding changes should now properly be permanent.
[/list]

Please let us know of any bugs you run into in our [url=https://discord.gg/tsyAn5gCSV]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7
notes.notes:
We’re excited to release Patch 1.0.7 and are immensely grateful for your support and patience. We understand that some of you still have been encountering challenges since the game’s launch, and we want to assure you we have been hard at work addressing your concerns throughout our patches.

With Patch 1.0.7, we’re taking another significant step towards improving your gameplay experience. We’ve been closely listening to player feedback and have focused our efforts these last two weeks on resolving two major issues that have been affecting some players since launch. Additionally, we’ve also worked on crash fixes and introduced some quality of life improvements. 

[h3][b]Major Changes :[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Map Tile Issues:[/b] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where some items/trees/stations from one map tile would not be properly positioned, giving the impression of two tiles “fusing” together. This fix should prevent the issue from happening again, but should also ensure that when you load a saved game, objects will be appropriately placed.
[*][b]Co-Op Game Joining:[/b] Some players reported challenges in joining co-op games with their friends. We have pinpointed why this was happening:[i][b] Previously if an error was raised during login with Steam or at game creation it would fail silently and start a game in offline mode. Thus, joining that game would always fail without warning. [/b][/i]To help clarify the status we have revamped some of the online flow to display error messages in the main menu in case the player login or the creation of the game session fails. This also allows players to choose to retry login/creation if they experienced a temporary network failure or go into offline mode. A successful state should be as transparent as it previously was. We hope this will alleviate most issues players encountered, but we are also investigating other ideas to let us better pinpoint other network failures.
[/list]
[h3][b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]We’ve fixed an issue that made the splash screen unskippable. 
[*]The basket now properly auto-selects the wanted item slot depending on a station’s inputs/outputs or the content of a chest.
[*]Fixed the basket not closing properly in certain situations.
[/list]
[h3][b]Other Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]We addressed a physics desync issue between clients and the host when picking up and putting on Fido’s basket, which caused player movement stuttering. 
[*]Did some fixes to quest Expo 67 around delivering some items.
[*]Fixed a crash caused by erroneous data in the construction mode that was revealed by the correction to the fences applied in 1.0.6. 
[/list]
[h3][b]Known Issues:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Clients in a co-op game may still experience menu map display issues (black screen). This does not affect the World Atlas map, and we are actively working on a fix which we are hoping to release next week.
[*]Localization for network error messages is not yet complete. This is on our radar, and we’ll be addressing it in a future update.
[/list]

Thank you for being a part of our community, and we can’t wait to see you in game with these new improvements!  As always, please let us know your feedback and if you experience  any bugs in our [url=https://discord.gg/by6mXXNs4S]Discord![/url]

The Madlife Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

[b]Patch 1.0.6[/b] is out and the main focus was given to the basket to make it easier to get items in/out of the forge and the evaporator. We also had the chance to introduce more fixes that we saw thanks to all of you. 


[u][b]Basket, mainly QoL :[/b][/u]
[list][*] Players can now put items in evaporators and forges from a basket in hand with the use button
[*] Basket opens automatically when hovering on an evaporator or forge
[*] They also can switch the selected item in the basket while hovering on producers
[*] They also can take evaporator/forge output through the interaction button
[*] They can sell items one by one from a basket in hand to a selling chest using the interaction button
[*] Adding item to the basket now automatically place it in the middle spot
[*] Fixed an issue where taking a stack of items from a container would erase the whole stack. [/list]

[u][b]Fence:[/b][/u]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where dropping a fence would block a constructible zone
[*] Building fences has been made more robust 
[*] Fixed an issue where one type of fence was not visible for non-host players [/list]

[u][b]Other fixes :[/b][/u]
[list][*] Fixed clients being unable to upgrade their tools
[*] Fixed firewood chest in build mode to be able to place it against a wall 
[*] Fixed the key
[*] Fixed “M” key binding to open map
[*] Fidos now teleport to their tile every morning like other NPCs. 
[*] Fixed a bug where non-host players would see all Fido as Blue Fido. 
[*] Fix canoe using the wrong spawn type
[*] In single player, opening the wardrobe will now pause the time 
[*] In single player, opening the atlas will now pause the time 
[*] Fixed restaurant music not being heard by non-host players.
[*] Fixed some typos in French localization [/list]

[u][b]Known issues we are working on! : [/b][/u]
[list][*] The clients in a co-op game cannot see the map correctly (black screen).
[*] The basket sometimes selects the wrong item when in front of a chest.
[*] Hosts fighting physics when picking up fido’s basket on clients’ side. [/list]


Please let us know of any bugs you run into in our [url=https://discord.gg/tsyAn5gCSV]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Thank you for bearing with us!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We know the last two weeks since release have been rough with bugs related to quests, NPC's, and multiplayer. As we strive to get every issue patched and fixed as quickly as we can, we wanted to ensure that all of our players know just how much we appreciate and value your support of our game.

We completely understand your frustrations and are hard at work fixing all the bugs and issues you have reported to us. These reports and feedback have been absolutely invaluable to us during this process. We apologize for the delay in this announcement, but our focus was on getting these important fixes out to you as quickly as we could.

[list][*] [b]Adjusted AI code to make all NPC reappear to quest spawn or to their house when their tiles are moved.[/b]
[*] [b]QoL[/b] : Change the way tools upgrade to give immediately the item to the player that is upgrading. It was frustrating, more than anything, to wait 3 days to get the new tool. If you were in the process of upgrading your tool, you will find it back with you when you load your game. 
[*] [b]QoL[/b] : All items present in chest and baskets on Antoine’s tile are used to check if you have the necessary materials for upgrades (like the Workbench). 
[*] [b]QoL[/b] : Changed lumberjack receiving the baked omelette to the center of the body instead of delivering it to Paul’s feet.
[*] Antoine now appears when you have 1 star reputation or if you repaired the lighthouse, to get access quicker to better tools.
[*] Fixed repairable areas like the well or the table that could be repaired before the quest prompt to do so, breaking the quests flow and progression.
[*] Fixed End quest that was broken by missing NPC
[*] Fixed Admiral that was broken by going missing
[*] Fixed Devil that was missing when moving a tile
[*] Fixed Catherine that was missing when moving a tile
[/list]

Please let us know of any bugs you run into in our [url=https://discord.gg/tsyAn5gCSV]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Patch 1.0.4 is a smaller hotfix focusing on mostly Quality of Life (QoL) improvements and the fix for multiplayer connection issues. We are still working on a bigger patch planned for later this week which will tackle the progression issues with NPC's. 

[list][*] [b]QoL[/b] : Reworked the UI to make it sharper and less blurry. It also fades slowly when moving players moves away
[*] [b]Tutorial QoL[/b] : Added instruction to go to sleep when finishing the intro quest the first night. 
[*] [b]Tutorial QoL[/b] : Added notifications prompt when a player joins or leaves your game.
[*] [b]Tutorial QoL[/b] : Added “Don't forget the plate” instruction to help the player understand why he can’t give meal to customer
[*] [b]Tutorial QoL[/b] : Added a notification to signal to the player that no recipe has been chosen when opening the restaurant
[*] Remove the 'enable multiplayer' option. This should fix all blackscreen issues when connecting to a friend’s game.
[*] Added missing Oven lvl 2 crafting recipe, RoadSlab 01 recipe, Sink lvl 1 and stove lvl 1 back to Alexis' shop. If you bought the recipe it should unlock automatically.
[*] Fixed NPCs customers getting stuck on stations and made sure that they can always reach the restaurant when the player opens it.
[*] Fixed an issue where moving a table while the restaurant was open would cause NPCs to sit in midair.
[*] Fixed Antoine axes not spawning at the same place during expo67
[*] Adjusted penalty from sleeping outside to 50$ per player who didn’t go to sleep rather than 100$ per player.
[*] Fixed typos and other localisation issues.
[/list]

Please let us know of any other bugs you run into in our [url=https://discord.gg/by6mXXNs4S]Discord[/url] so that we can work to get them fixed as quickly as possible!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Sugar Shack Community

We want to express our heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you for your incredible support since the release of Sugar Shack. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've been hard at work addressing the issues and making your gaming experience even sweeter.

With Patch 1.0.2, we've poured our hearts and souls into rectifying the issues you've brought to our attention. We've focused on enhancing your quality of life in the game and squashing a range of bugs and glitches you have reported.  

[h3]So without further ado here is a rundown of Patch 1.02[/h3]

[h2]We have fixed a memory leak that could freeze Steam Decks and PC[/h2]

[h1]NPC/Quest Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Quest with Admiral Walker not showing up when fishing.[i][b] If you missed the Admiral in your current save game, he will find you instead![/b][/i]
[*] Fixed Devil’s disappearance in multiple quests.
[*] Fixed an issue where the wood plank recipe would not be available to buy at the Devil’s house after a reload.
[*] Fixed Antoine not spawning when reloading the game.
[*] Fixed Corriveau not giving you a reward when she comes back from Expo 67.
[*] Fixed Catherine disappearing during her quest.
[*]The furnace crafting recipe is now unlocked correctly after repairing Antoine’s furnace. [i][b] Older save games that should have received it will receive it the next time they start the game.[/b][/i]
[/list]

[h1]Shack & Build Mode Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed rugs so they can now be placed properly.
[*] Made wall collisions taller so players hopefully no longer get items stuck over the walls.
[*] Added invisible “slip ’n slides” on repairable holes in the floor and broken furniture and shelves so baskets are less likely to get stuck on them.
[*] New [b]“Build Mode”[/b] tutorial screen available in the tutorial menu.
[*]Improved the collision of the small stairs between the kitchen and dining area so players don’t get blocked when climbing the stairs at an angle.
[/list]

[h1]Workbench Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Workbench can now be interacted with by a simple click instead of holding[/b]
[*] [b]Workbench can now access a basket's inventory if it placed on the same world tile![/b]
[*] The sprinkler’s crafting recipe now shows up correctly in the recipes menu and on the workbench once it is unlocked. [i][b]Older save games that should have received it will receive it the next time they start the game.[/b][/i]
[*] Made it so the chest near Alexis workbench is no longer moveable to prevent issues happening.
[*] Fixed a stacking issue where crafting a wooden plank would give a single plank instead of two.
[*] Fixed players being locked in multiplayer if someone tries to craft something while someone else changes the menu.
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] Tools can bow be upgraded for non-host players in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed a bug for non-host players so that they can see the map in multiplayer. 
[*] Fixed some replication issues in multiplayer.
[/list]

[h1]Other Gameplay Improvements & Exploits [/h1]
[list]
[*] Your restaurant menu choices are now saved, even after reload.
[*] We've improved night lighting, night's should appear less dark. 
[*] Dirt should no longer spawn in the restaurant when there are no clients. [i] We blame the devil for that one.[/i]
[*] Lighthouse and Antoine's forge should now follow their tiles when moving them in the Mystic Atlas
[*] Fixed a bug where the Stove would disappear, [i]Thanks @Skullskillz![/i]
[*] Selling salmon pies will now give you money-- [i]we aren't running a charity here.[/i]
[*] Corrected multiple typos.
[*] Fixed [b]Ice Fishing Tutorial[/b] not being available in the tutorials menu once you unlock the tutorial.
[*] Changed SFX four outdoor stereo sounds and attenuation settings.
[*] We see you! We have fixed an issue where the price of recipes in Corriveau's shop were $0. [i]Sorry, but no more free recipes.[/i]
[*] Modified available seeds at Corriveau’s shop so they can be unlocked earlier for recipes.
[*] We know you LOVE your brooms. We fixed the broom holder missing its broom on a new day if the players tries to sleep with it. 
[*] Fixed time of day and money UI disappearing when reloading a save.
[*] Fixed tool wheel not showing up when reloading a save or sleeping with a broom. [i][b]Sleeping will always make the tool wheel available now.[/b][/i]
[*] Fixed trapdoor not showing up properly on tile. [i][b]We had one last BIG snowfall this spring and it was buried under the snow.[/b][/i]
[*] Added logo to Windows application for the game.
[*] Made optimizations on poly count to get even more frames.
[*] Fixed an issue where disabling Vsync would not do anything.
[*] Made cosmetic changes to some assets, we think they look even better than before. 
[*] Forced the game to start with DirectX12. On some configurations, it would run with DirectX11 which would crash.
[*] [i]Other small fixes and improvements.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Sweet Friday #005 - The build mode
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Daryl here again with another blog post about Sugar Shack. 

For this Sweet Friday, we want to talk about our past building system and how we came up with our current building system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/def3cc674408d4dbab386630f9b0d27fb5e37822.png[/img]

In the past we tried to use a “build mode” system where the player would select with the mouse where the items would go. However, it did not work at all because it was confusing for playtesters to understand how it worked and what the new controls were. 

It also had the issue of breaking the immersion as objects in the world are persistent in some form (either as a pickable item or placed in the world). But now, you have this global inventory where players could drop items in there and make it disappear temporarily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/56a13aa29b21f3988138e75f360ae66c5c128b7b.gif[/img]

In the end, we decided to pick the same system of picking / dropping items than the rest of the game for simplicity and consistency. If you know how to pick items on the ground, you will be familiar with this system as well. However, it was sometimes cumbersome to pick-drop-pick-drop items, especially for elements like roads. For these, we made them stackable so that players can just pick-drop-drop-drop to create their roads. 

To remove items, we like the idea of pulling the pickaxe and breaking what you did. It worked well and it was easily understandable. In Sugar Shack, items are not destroyed when broken, so players can easily pick them back up and place them where they wished to be placed initially.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/a6ad11da3340ba543538440761d793d4d7a888a7.gif[/img]

We can’t wait to see your different worlds take shape! 

We’re looking forward to our next blog post! If you don't want to miss it, follow us on social media and if you haven’t already, wishlist the game. It helps us a ton to get more visibility!

See you soon in the Shack! 
Daryl B.

notes.title: Sweet Friday #004 - The customisation system
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Daryl here again with another blog post about Sugar Shack. 

For this Sweet Friday, we want to explain how the player can customize their shack and their world with elements like roads, chest, decorations and more. 

We want to show how to add, remove, rotate and modify objects that are placed into the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/990064cc40795301a2f5e10345237aec076c0f63.png[/img]

Objects can be placed by simply being picked up by the player. If the position is valid, the object will be highlighted in blue and if it’s not a valid position, it will be in red. A grid appears to show where an item can be placed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/8205666cffd8068a22b8eb6991d67ecb625c11dc.gif[/img]

Since our outside world is hexagonal but the interior is rectangular, there are two grids for players to position their items. One is a square and the other is a hexagonal grid. It became way easier to place items outside and inside and to know where an item would fall on the grid. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/e18e2860d12c208ada79de4a7198941a4089cfa2.png[/img]

We’re looking forward to our next blog post! If you don't want to miss it, follow us on social media and if you haven’t already, wishlist the game. It helps us a ton to get more visibility!

See you soon in the Shack! 
Daryl B.

notes.title: Sweet Friday #003 - Maple, trees and production
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We are back once again for a sweeeeeet Friday! We are at the third entry already. And this time, we jump right into the maple action. If it’s your first Sweet Friday, each month we dive into a single system in Sugar Shack to explain our reasoning, design choices, and how they affect the gameplay. Previously, we talked about tiles and inventory management. In case you haven’t seen them already, go check them out!

So how is the precious maple syrup made in Sugar Shack, you ask? Well, we decided to go with the old, traditional ways. You get a bucket (through crafting or shopping), tap a tree, and leave the bucket there for a while to get your beautiful maple sap. At this stage, you will need to boil it like they did in the past. No fancy evaporator here. Get out your marmite and get cooking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/0f5b7bdf89c11a50a2e573ad8af64e8a0af22a8b.gif[/img]

Once you wait long enough, the maple syrup will be ready to be collected. It’s as simple as that. Now you can use this maple syrup for many things. Cooking, selling, and even glue... Not really a classic usage of it, but hey if it works… But let’s be honest, you will probably use it to cook for your dear customers or sell it. I heard one devious character is looking to buy a LOT of maple syrup. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/be0bbcfabd97a65aca4af71bfe15381539cefc1e.gif[/img]

We wanted to keep this simple enough to provide a good gameplay loop of tapping trees, collecting sap, and boiling it to get maple syrup. You will quickly realize that one evaporator is not enough. Soon you will want more, to provide your shack with the precious, oh-so-precious liquid. This is where it gets more challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/a3606d93a8cce4378cdd2f13a04f72c5a3f198ba.gif[/img]

As we are not doing a simulator type of game and we wanted to keep it simple for everyone to enjoy. We didn’t go super hard on the process of making syrup (keeping an exact temperature, cleaning the machine, removing the syrup from the fire before it burns, etc.).
It’s not impossible in the future that we add the different types of maple syrup made from longer evaporation times (like the dark grade maple syrup, the gold grade one, etc.) or try to add more complexity to the loop by means of automation, but for now, we are fully focused on getting this massive game out the door for you to try and enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/3bd94ec10f06096963f311e9ad124d2a25503885.png[/img]

Now for updates about the production! The team has been working hard this past month on polishing the current systems in the game. Lots of fun stuff has been added in, like the new boat that will be used to get you new customers every morning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/0994eb729ff7d9076e05a92f9e3b1280d9af3b49.png[/img]

The shack also underwent a bit of a transformation and is currently not soooo clean. Awww, it is in a right state, isn’t it? Well, good news! You now have a broom to keep the shack clean and tidy during after-service, and you can start slowly repairing it to its former glory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/e158a53317b7a1a37ab779c2941e410a339d0c6b.png[/img]

As always, more stuff is coming, but that will be kept secret until the next Sweet Friday… maybe. Also, keep an eye out for the exact release date later this year. As we are getting closer and closer to release, we feel more confident in pinpointing an exact date soon.


See you soon in the Shack! 
Daryl Barampanze.

notes.title: Sweet Friday #002 - Inventory and item management
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Daryl B. here. 
We meet once again for another iteration of our Sweet Friday! This time, we will dive into item management and inventory. Without further ado, let’s get started. 

In Sugar Shack, there is no inventory bar, no UI popup or notification when you gather an item. In fact, your character has no inventory at all. You can only transport a single “item” at a time with you. (I put “item” in quotes because it is effectively anything that can be carried out.) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/da949c9d616e73292ba29fdab10ff5234f7eec49.png[/img]
 
There are multiple reasons why we picked this choice and I want to explain them in this blog post. During development we tried going the usual management game way by using an inventory, toolbars and quickslots but none of them were good enough for what we were doing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/f722c0b7bb3828be6fb9f97a18bc12f553b0d7a5.png[/img]
This is an old screenshot of the game with that system.

The main reason for why that was the case was due to being blocked by a menu every time you wanted to use something. For example, a chest would open a popup so that you can select what to pick in your inventory and what to drop - think a la minecraft/stardew. The oven would require you to drop the selected items to pick the recipe and let you know if you could make it. The worst part was in the restaurant: while you were busy browsing menus, you could not see new clients requesting orders or being angry. Everything felt sluggish and we truly felt it prevented people from enjoying the game. 

This is why we took the decision to remove the idea of an inventory on the character completely and remove most UI prompts as well! This single decision affected the game a lot. For example, your chests only stock a single item type in them so that you can pick it directly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/a1247698d5c5d6d16c59b89036cf909f182d1d3d.png[/img]

The different cooking stations are now very simple to use. A single click and you go right to business. For example, this is how to take a log from a log rack to put it on a chopping block. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/c431c9454ca3aa593bc2b747da1dc87f09c0b705.gif[/img]

And this is a short example of how to cook. Everything is more direct, simple and clear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/1a669923c1b60ca6ba4a036f4aeca4ab7938bb99.gif[/img]

You might also wonder: how would that affect gathering? This is one area where you need an inventory and since we have none, well that’s an issue. This is why I started this blog post with “item” in quotes: what if you could carry a bag that can store other items? This way we can keep the simplicity of use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/915650b06198a3cdcd141c766d363edec900973e.gif[/img]

You can pick up a bag and use it to store items as you move through the world. To prevent back and forth, you can also throw items (and the bag will catch it). To pick an item from it, open the bag and pick it up! We might almost give it some legs… maybe in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/e405f0f905c29ea3215da45bbd19415f57679f66.gif[/img]

I personally think we found a sweet spot between immersion, interaction and action you can do. So far we are pretty happy about it, but it might change in the future. I also wanted to talk about maple trees and syrup but typing this text, I realize that it might be too long. So, it will be for the next edition of the sweet friday in a month. 

As a quick note: we will be at PAX East this year! If you have the chance to drop by, come say hi. There will be a short demo to try too. See you there! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/0468afa8a1007acdcb5fda4950b9911ea66c893d.gif[/img]

See you soon in the Shack! 
Daryl Barampanze.

notes.title: Sweet Friday #001 - Dynamic Tiles System
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Daryl B. here. I’m the lead programmer on Sugar Shack!

This post is the first in a series in which we wanted to take the time to explore the game in greater detail and showcase how the world of Sugar Shack works. Each month, we will dive deeper into one aspect of the game and also talk a little bit about what the team has been up to during that time. Let’s not waste anymore time - this month we are talking about the tile system!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/38a28d442ccc1e680b72828ec50bc13309c1e5d3.png[/img]

As you can see, the world in Sugar Shack is divided into hexagonal tiles which you have the absolute control of. As you explore, complete quests, and progress through the game, you will receive many tiles to add to your map. You choose what goes where! 

That freedom of placement is super important to us. Like you, we’ve played other games in the genre and something that always bothered us is how fixed the world is. If you want to go to the shop, then the shop would be at this fixed position. While it is great for design, because you know how long it takes to go there, where it is, what’s behind and in front, it can be taxing for the player. What if I don’t like the shop position? Maybe I would like this NPC that I like super close to me? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/bea41be07496b1d1b02662eb0d39d1a6fef1289d.png[/img]

Doing this introduces a lot of challenges from many perspectives. How do you save an ever changing world? How do you design a game where the objective can be 5 minutes near you or 15 minutes away from you? None of this is easy or trivial. We had to take a couple of hard decisions to pick what’s right and is fitting for our game. For example, when you build something at the end of a tile, it won’t necessarily be a valid position because either tile 1 or tile 2 could potentially be the owner of that element. Moving tile 1 should be obvious in what should move with it. However, there is one exception: roads. As they go between tiles, we are not sure which tile should keep the road piece that connects the two tiles (or is it lost forever?). If you do have an idea, let us know in the comments below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/ab5a647273c10f20137a03056f752afeec76c2f7.png[/img]

This idea of using tiles came from our love of board games where you can usually construct your land from parcels. And in these games, tiles do influence each other. So, we decided to make our lives even harder: what if they could influence each other? Each tile might get a bonus effect if it is placed in a certain configuration. For example, your maple trees could produce more sap in the right condition. Or your garden could be watered automatically each morning! It will be up to you to decide and discover these combinations and decide what to do with this knowledge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/4229c0f3d9ba35777567b8e7009eb3a1655b038c.png[/img]

We liked this idea so much that we pushed and pushed to make it happen and now, it is working and functional. We hope that once you have the game in hand, you will find this idea as enchanting as we do. We can’t wait to see your different worlds take shape! 

In the next blog post, we will talk more about item management, maple trees and the production of syrup. If you don't want to miss it, give us a follow on [url=https://twitter.com/MadLifeGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/madlifedivertissement/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/MadLifeGames]Facebook[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.gg/tsyAn5gCSV]Discord[/url] community!

[url=https://discord.gg/tsyAn5gCSV][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288681/0468afa8a1007acdcb5fda4950b9911ea66c893d.gif[/img][/url]

See you soon in the Shack! 
Daryl B.
